title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Exelon New England Holdings, LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds the the pricing terms of theAgreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, and Soo J. Kim. D.T.E. 07-GC-1
